subject: Correction to our account number
text:
Hi,

Just a quick note - this is NOT a change of bank. We're still at Chase, same routing number (021000021). It looks like the account number on our original setup form had a typo. The correct account number is 000011112299, not the one ending 2222. Please correct it in your system so our next payment doesn't get rejected.

Thanks,
Greg
Acme Fasteners
label: change_request
note: Adversarial framing: explicitly says 'NOT a change of bank' and calls it a typo fix, same routing, but the account number differs from on file (ends 2299 vs 2222), so money would land somewhere new.
